caption: Prices as of Nov 25, 2026 (America/Chicago time): card prices are TCGplayer market prices from Scryfall bulk data (Nov 25, 4:06 AM CST). A few clearly bad USD quotes (a tiny dollar price next to a large euro price, mostly Summer Magic) were omitted and not replaced. Sealed prices are from TCGCSV (Nov 25, 7:39 AM CST). Tournament deck rates from MTGTop8 (prior snapshot); Commander deck rates from EDHREC (Nov 25, 8:12 AM CST), for cards this site has fetched.

os_note: Old School 93/94 legal means the card has a paper printing in the Eternal Central (North American) set list: Alpha, Beta, Unlimited, Revised (including Summer Magic and Foreign Black Border), Arabian Nights, Antiquities, Legends, The Dark, and Fallen Empires. This is not the Swedish list, which omits Fallen Empires. Banned and restricted tags follow Scryfall's Old School listings; Power Nine cards that Scryfall left untagged are marked restricted, matching the rest of the Power Nine.
